items.headline: ECB holds deposit rate at 2.50% as eurozone inflation hits 3.8%
items.why: Signals ECB tightening bias into Dec; higher-for-longer EU rates pressure growth-stock multiples incl. AI names

items.headline: Fed holds rates at 3.75%-4.00% in 10-2 split FOMC vote, says inflation remains elevated
items.why: Signals Fed in no rush to cut further despite AI capex-driven growth; keeps financing costs for AI buildouts elevated

items.headline: PBOC injects record ~1 trillion yuan overnight liquidity, plus 700bn yuan MLF operation
items.why: Aggressive China liquidity easing supports China AI-equity complex (Alibaba, Tencent) and risk appetite

items.headline: Nvidia and AMD to invest $4B combined in Meta's equity offering; Broadcom joins for $5B total
items.why: Chipmakers bankrolling a hyperscaler's AI capex deepens vendor-customer financial entanglement across the AI supply chain

items.headline: Meta announces $95B stock offering to fund AI infrastructure expansion
items.why: Confirms hyperscaler capex supercycle is accelerating, not plateauing, feeding chip and data-center demand

items.headline: Anthropic files S-1 to list on Nasdaq as "ANT"; Bloomberg says deal could value it near $2T, trading as soon as Nov 16
items.why: First AI-lab mega-IPO gives investors direct public exposure to frontier AI and a read-through valuation for OpenAI/xAI

items.headline: Anthropic's IPO filing discloses plans to spend up to $567B on compute
items.why: Quantifies scale of AI capex commitments and compute dependency underpinning Anthropic's growth and margin outlook

items.headline: SpaceX locks in ~$40B GPU/data-center financing deal with Apollo Global Management via a lease structure
items.why: Shows AI capex spreading via off-balance-sheet leasing even to non-AI-core companies - a structure to watch for hidden leverage

items.headline: Alibaba, ByteDance and Tencent order hundreds of thousands of Huawei Ascend 950 chips after DeepSeek V4 adapts to them
items.why: Shows China's AI stack decoupling from Nvidia in practice as DeepSeek V4 gets full-stack support on domestic chips

items.headline: SK Group's data-center arm in talks to fund a $350B AI buildout
items.why: Shows non-US capital mobilizing at hyperscaler scale behind AI infrastructure, widening the compute financing base

items.headline: OpenAI nears up to $30B funding round at $1.25T valuation led by UAE investors
items.why: Sets a new benchmark private AI-lab valuation and signals sovereign-wealth capital deepening its stake in OpenAI ahead of a 2027 IPO

items.headline: Nvidia and supply-chain partners announce capacity expansion to accelerate AI infrastructure buildout
items.why: Signals Nvidia moving to ease the capacity bottlenecks constraining AI chip and server supply

items.headline: Nvidia's guarantees and commitments backing new AI data centers reach up to $164.5B, report says
items.why: Shows scale of Nvidia's off-balance-sheet exposure to the AI buildout, a key solvency/circularity risk

items.headline: Anthropic reportedly eyeing IPO as early as mid-November at ~$2T valuation, up from $965B private mark
items.why: Would be the largest AI IPO yet and a key read on public-market appetite for AI-lab valuations
